name: Oshirikko Venus 2
source: The sequel to Oshirikko Venus. Tooyama is now in a relationship with Shizuku but a new heroine Nishizono Suzune comes into play. The new teacher that transfer to school begins to take an interest in Tooyama and also happens to have a butt that Tooyama can't look away from.
